thread:
Mia Chen: Hey team — dropping the first full draft of the product post for the new Dedicated runtime. Looking for a quick legal/privacy pass, a UX copy sweep, and confirmation on funnel tracking before we schedule publish. TL;DR at bottom.

Samir Patel: reading now. can you paste the benchmark callout copy? we should make sure the metric framing matches the bench deck.

Mia Chen: sure — here's the callout we plan to use: 
```
Bench: 3x throughput at 50% lower token cost vs baseline on A100 with our batching + cache profile.
Notes: measured across 2 public workloads (chat, summarize).
```
Please flag anything that sounds like a claim we can't support.

Lina Gomez: copy edits — small stuff: change "3x" -> "up to 3x" unless bench doc always shows that exact median; and swap "cost" -> "per-token cost". Also suggest the opening paragraph be friendlier: start with the customer problem, not the product.

Rafael Cruz: also, we should include a CTA to the webinar we planned for next Tues. If we link to the registration page, make sure marketing ops (Ashley) confirms the UTM params and that registrants get routed to the right SDR queue.

Ashley Park: I can confirm. Proposed UTMs: utm_source=blog, utm_medium=organic, utm_campaign=dedicated_rt_launch. For HubSpot routing, please use form id `hs_form_324` and include hidden field `product_line=dedicated`. I can set automation to assign MQL->SDR queue "dedicated-launch" when utm_campaign matches. @Mia Chen leave me a note when the publish date is locked.

Marcom Bot: Checklist update — legal review requested (status: pending), SEO meta ready (status: draft), images pending (status: need assets), publish window requested (status: none). Add `#publish-checklist` to update.

Mia Chen: noted. Legal, pinging @Samir Patel and @Lina Gomez — do either of you want to loop legal ops directly? We have the benchmark appendix in the drive: https://drive.google.com/d/1-example-bench-appendix

Samir Patel: I think legal ops should glance. I'll file a quick request: short note + appendix. @LegalOps can you review claim language in the "Bench" snippet? (CC: @Lina Gomez)

Lina Gomez: accepting edits: I'll replace the first para with customer problem + move the technical paragraph below the header. Also I'll swap the subject line options. Draft subject lines: 
```
- See how Dedicated runtime cuts token costs for production apps
- Reduce inference costs without trading latency — meet Dedicated runtime
- New: predictable, high-throughput inference for teams
```
Which do we prefer for AB test?

Mia Chen: I like option 2 for paid/social, option 1 for email. We'll A/B the headline on the web.

Ashley Park: routing confirmed. Also note: add hidden field `origin=blog` to the form so we can segment. I'll add the automation rule after the draft is live.

Rafael Cruz: webinar snippet to include (1-sentence): "Join our engineering lead for a deep-dive on throughput patterns, live Q&A, and a demo." I'll draft the registration link blurb and share.

Marcom Bot: Reminder: Please attach final hero image (min 1200x675) and variant 1 for social cards. Assets folder: s3://redwood-marketing/dedicated-launch/assets

Mia Chen: action items I captured: 1) Lina — apply copy edits and subject variants; 2) Samir — file legal ops request + confirm bench phrasing; 3) Ashley — prep HubSpot form + UTMs; 4) Rafael — write webinar blurb + registration link; 5) Design — export hero and social cards to the S3 folder. I'll reconvene for a 15-min sync tomorrow 9am PT to sign off. If legal passes before then we can schedule publish for Thursday. :thumbsup:

Samir Patel: LGTM on plan. filing legal ticket now.

Lina Gomez: on it — will push a copy update tonight and post the revised excerpt here for final read.

Ashley Park: saved the UTMs and form notes. I'll stand by for publish date.

Rafael Cruz: drafting webinar blurb, will post in the thread when ready.

Mia Chen: thanks all — please add any final nitpicks here, otherwise I'll mark the thread for approval after the sync. :party-parrot:
